title: Shaass and Oskols
statementMd:
Shaass has decided to hunt some birds. There are $*n*$ horizontal electricity wires aligned parallel to each other. Wires are numbered $1$ to $*n*$ from top to bottom. On each wire there are some oskols sitting next to each other. Oskol is the name of a delicious kind of birds in Shaass's territory. Supposed there are $*a*_{*i*}$ oskols sitting on the $*i*$-th wire.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f140cc8456f91e2cf28fded4f048683d274d4f9e.png)

Sometimes Shaass shots one of the birds and the bird dies (suppose that this bird sat at the $*i*$-th wire). Consequently all the birds on the $*i*$-th wire to the left of the dead bird get scared and jump up on the wire number $*i* - 1$, if there exists no upper wire they fly away. Also all the birds to the right of the dead bird jump down on wire number $*i* + 1$, if there exists no such wire they fly away.

Shaass has shot $*m*$ birds. You're given the initial number of birds on each wire, tell him how many birds are sitting on each wire after the shots.

## Input

The first line of the input contains an integer $*n*$, $(1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100)$. The next line contains a list of space-separated integers $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$, $(0 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 100)$.

The third line contains an integer $*m*$, $(0 ≤ *m* ≤ 100)$. Each of the next $*m*$ lines contains two integers $*x*_{*i*}$ and $*y*_{*i*}$. The integers mean that for the $*i*$-th time Shaass shoot the $*y*_{*i*}$-th (from left) bird on the $*x*_{*i*}$-th wire, $(1 ≤ *x*_{*i*} ≤ *n*, 1 ≤ *y*_{*i*})$. It's guaranteed there will be at least $*y*_{*i*}$ birds on the $*x*_{*i*}$-th wire at that moment.

## Output

On the $*i*$-th line of the output print the number of birds on the $*i*$-th wire.
statementZhMd:
Shaass 决定猎杀一些鸟。有 $*n*$ 根水平电线彼此平行排列。电线从上到下编号为 $1$ 到 $*n*$。每根电线上都有一些彼此相邻的 Oskol。Oskol 是 Shaass 所在地区一种美味的鸟。假设第 $*i*$ 根电线上有 $*a*_{*i*}$ 只 Oskol。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f140cc8456f91e2cf28fded4f048683d274d4f9e.png)

有时 Shaass 会射杀其中一只鸟（假设这只鸟位于第 $*i*$ 根电线上）。随后，第 $*i*$ 根电线上位于死鸟左侧的所有鸟都会受到惊吓，跳到编号为 $*i* - 1$ 的电线上；如果不存在上方的电线，它们就会飞走。死鸟右侧的所有鸟也会跳到编号为 $*i* + 1$ 的电线上；如果不存在这样的电线，它们就会飞走。

Shaass 一共射杀了 $*m*$ 只鸟。给出每根电线上的鸟的初始数量，请你告诉他射击后每根电线上有多少只鸟。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$，$(1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100)$。下一行包含一个由空格分隔的整数列表 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$，$(0 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 100)$。

第三行包含一个整数 $*m*$，$(0 ≤ *m* ≤ 100)$。接下来的 $*m*$ 行中，每行包含两个整数 $*x*_{*i*}$ 和 $*y*_{*i*}$。这些整数表示在第 $*i*$ 次射击中，Shaass 射杀第 $*x*_{*i*}$ 根电线上的第 $*y*_{*i*}$ 只（从左数）鸟，$(1 ≤ *x*_{*i*} ≤ *n*, 1 ≤ *y*_{*i*})$。保证在当时第 $*x*_{*i*}$ 根电线上至少有 $*y*_{*i*}$ 只鸟。

## 输出格式

输出 $*n*$ 行，第 $*i*$ 行输出第 $*i*$ 根电线上的鸟的数量。
